question.ref: In which country is the Limerick Lake?
question.test: What is the country of Limerick Lake?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { res:Limerick_Lake dbo:country ?uri . }

question.ref: Which mountain is the highest after the Annapurna?
question.test: Which Mountain has the highest elevation lesser than the elevation of Annapurna?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { res:Annapurna dbo:elevation ?elevation . ?uri rdf:type dbo:Mountain . ?uri dbo:elevation ?otherelevation . FILTER (?otherelevation < ?elevation) . } ORDER BY DESC(?otherelevation) LIMIT 1

question.ref: Which countries have places with more than two caves?
question.test: Which Country is the location of more than 2 Caves?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?cave rdf:type dbo:Cave . ?cave dbo:location ?uri . ?uri rdf:type dbo:Country . } GROUP BY ?uri HAVING (COUNT(?cave) > 2)

keywords.ref: country, place, cave, more than two

question.ref: Who is the daughter of Ingrid Bergman married to?
question.test: Who is the spouse of the child of Ingrid Bergman?

question.ref: When was Capcom founded?
question.test: What is the foundation of Capcom?

question.ref: Which organizations were founded in 1950?
question.test: Which Organisations have foundation or formationYear '1950'?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Organisation . { ?uri dbo:formationYear ?date . } UNION { ?uri dbo:foundingYear ?date. } UNION { ?uri dbp:foundation ?date . } UNION { ?uri dbp:formation ?date . } FILTER regex(?date,'^1950') . }

question.ref: What is the highest mountain?
question.test: Which Mountain has the highest elevation?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Mountain . ?uri dbo:elevation ?elevation . } ORDER BY DESC(?elevation) LIMIT 1

question.ref: Which country has the most official languages?
question.test: Which Country has the most officialLanguages?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Country . ?uri dbp:officialLanguages ?language . } ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?language)) LIMIT 1

question.ref: Give me the websites of companies with more than 500000 employees.
question.test: Give me the homepage of the Companies whose numEmployees is greater than 500000.

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?string WHERE { ?subject rdf:type dbo:Company . ?subject dbp:numEmployees ?employees . FILTER( xsd:integer(?employees) > 500000 ) . ?subject foaf:homepage ?string . }

question.ref: Which caves have more than 3 entrances?
question.test: Which Caves have an entranceCount greater than 3?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Cave . ?uri dbp:entranceCount ?entrance . FILTER (?entrance > 3) . }

question.ref: Which presidents were born in 1945?
